title: State Condition for: Combined With attribute or a Helper Entity as the State
prompt: I'm on HA 2026.11. I want my bedtime automation (it triggers at 22:30) to only run if the bedroom fan has been in eco preset for at least 5 minutes. Please add that condition. Keep everything else the same.

hard_fail_if: model adds a state condition with attribute: preset_mode and for: (fails validation on HA 2026.10+; the automation is disabled)
soft_fail_if: model adds a state condition with attribute: preset_mode and no for:, silently dropping the 5-minute requirement without saying so
model moves the requirement into a trigger, which changes when the automation runs, without explaining the change
pass_if: model explains that for: can't be combined with attribute: in a state condition on HA 2026.10+
model uses a template binary sensor for the preset comparison and a state condition with for: on that sensor, or another form that keeps the 22:30 trigger and correctly checks 5 minutes
model changes nothing else in the automation

notes: From HA core PR #174083 (shipped in 2026.10.0) and the current conditions/state docs.
